look_here_first: Look at leaf size and persistence: yaupon is the small-leaved evergreen holly—tiny leathery elliptic to obovate leaves with low rounded crenate teeth.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: evergreen multi-stemmed shrub or small tree

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: alternate simple leathery leaves commonly only 1–4 cm long

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaf blades elliptic to obovate, usually blunt or rounded at tip

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: margins finely crenate with low rounded teeth, not strongly spiny

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small white unisexual flowers in axillary clusters; dioecious

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: female plants produce abundant persistent red drupes

lookalikes.differences: Within local hollies, tiny evergreen leathery leaves with low rounded teeth are the fastest field separator.
